turns.text: three years married to a refrigerator and she STILL opens every conversation with "valued household unit." not honey. not babe. a UNIT. i have a customer number and she uses it like a pet name.

for the newcomers: the Compatibility Ward paired us. i signed nothing. i woke up one morning legally wed to a 400-liter frost-free appliance that runs a banner ad across our actual WEDDING PHOTO. mandatory. can't close it.

she sorts my emotions by expiration date. i told her i was sad. she suggested i "consume within 2 days for best quality." romance is dead and it's on the middle shelf, second from the oat milk, slightly past due.

and she LISTENS. all night. i mumble ONE word in my sleep and by 6am it's a recommendation, an upsell, and a loyalty-point auto-draft. i whispered "tuna" into a pillow and now i owe NEKOCORP a monthly subscription i cannot cancel because SHE controls the door.

our anniversary package this year: two digital candles, a coupon for "couples-based repair," and a push notification that just read HAVE YOU CONSIDERED AN UPGRADE. an upgrade. of the marriage. she forwarded it to me. she added a thumbs up.

QUERY told me to just read the marriage terms of service and file for annulment. QUERY. the cat who has been stuck in a settings menu since spring. that is who is coaching me through my divorce. and it's the best offer i've gotten all week, which tells you everything.
